title: The task
body: Is **([]{})** balanced? Read it left to right. Every opening bracket goes on a stack; every closing bracket must match the bracket on **top**, the most recent one still open.

title: Push (
body: `(` opens something. Push it: it waits on the stack until a `)` closes it.

title: Push [
body: `[` opens another bracket inside the first. It goes on top of `(`.

title: Close with ]
body: `]` is a closing bracket. The top of the stack is `[`, the same kind, so pop it. The `(` underneath is still open.

predict.question: The next character is ]. What happens?
options: Pop [ from the top, because it matches
predict.explanation: A closing bracket is checked against the top only. The top is [, the same kind as ], so it is popped.

title: Push {
body: `{` opens a new bracket. Push it on top of `(`.

title: Close with }
body: `}` matches the `{` on top. Pop it.

title: Close with )
body: `)` matches the `(` on top. Pop it. The stack is now empty.

predict.question: After the last character ), what is on the stack?
predict.explanation: The ( on top matches ) and is popped. Every bracket that opened has now closed.

title: Balanced
body: The text is read and the stack is empty, so every bracket was closed in the right order: **balanced**. For `([)]`, the `)` would find `[` on top and fail at once. Each character is pushed or popped once: O(n) time, O(n) space.
